triggers.description: A trigger event occurs if the aggregate class principal amount of the subordinate certificates has been reduced to zero prior to distributions or allocations on the distribution date.

A trigger event occurs if aggregate realized losses attributable to the 23-HE1 PC since the cut-off date through the end of the related monthly period, divided by the aggregate certificate principal amount of all certificates other than Class A-1, exceeds 5%.

A trigger event occurs if the six-month average of the monthly percentage of HELOC-related mortgage loans that are 60 or more days delinquent, including foreclosure, REO or bankruptcy status but excluding charged-off loans and loans subject to a forbearance plan, divided by the aggregate certificate principal amount of all certificates other than Class A-1, exceeds 5%.
